name: Amber Fort
description: Hilltop fort-palace above Maota Lake, about 11 km from the city centre. Online sources disagree on ticket price and closing time; verify.

name: City Palace
description: Royal palace complex with museums in the old city; part of it is still a royal residence.

name: Hawa Mahal
description: Pink sandstone facade with latticed windows, in the old city.

name: Jantar Mantar
description: 18th-century astronomical observatory with large stone instruments; UNESCO World Heritage Site.

name: Nahargarh Fort
description: Hilltop fort above the city, popular for sunset views.

name: Jaigarh Fort
description: Fort on the ridge above Amber Fort, with a very large cannon (Jaivana).

name: Albert Hall Museum
description: Museum in an Indo-Saracenic building; also open in the evening (separate night ticket).

name: Jal Mahal
description: Palace in the middle of Man Sagar Lake, viewed from the lakeside promenade; visitors cannot go inside.

name: Johari Bazaar
description: Traditional jewellery, textile and handicraft market in the old city; many shops close on Sundays.

name: Laxmi Misthan Bhandar (LMB)
description: Long-established vegetarian sweets shop and restaurant on Johari Bazaar.

name: Mehrangarh Fort
description: Large fort on a rocky hill above the old Blue City, with a museum and palace rooms.

name: Jaswant Thada
description: White marble cenotaph near Mehrangarh Fort.

name: Umaid Bhawan Palace Museum
description: Museum in one part of a working palace hotel; the rest of the palace is not open to day visitors.

name: Clock Tower and Sardar Market
description: Busy market around the clock tower in the old city, known for spices, textiles and handicrafts.

name: Mandore Gardens
description: Gardens and historic cenotaphs on the site of the former capital, about 9 km north of the centre.

name: Mishrilal Hotel (makhaniya lassi)
description: Shop near the clock tower known for its saffron-flavoured lassi.

name: City Palace, Udaipur
description: Palace complex on the bank of Lake Pichola, with a museum.

name: Lake Pichola
description: Large lake beside the City Palace; boat rides run from the palace jetties and prices vary.

name: Jagdish Temple
description: Vishnu temple next to the City Palace; entry is free.

name: Saheliyon Ki Bari
description: Garden with fountains and a lotus pool, north of the old city.

name: Sajjangarh (Monsoon Palace)
description: Hilltop palace west of the city, popular for sunset views; a fee is charged for the road in.

name: Bagore Ki Haveli
description: 18th-century haveli museum on Lake Pichola; evening folk dance shows are held here.

name: Fateh Sagar Lake
description: Artificial lake north-west of the old city with a lakeside promenade.

name: Brahma Temple
description: One of the few temples dedicated to Brahma; dress modestly and check the rules on phones and cameras.

name: Pushkar Lake and Ghats
description: Holy lake ringed by bathing ghats; the town is vegetarian and alcohol-free.

name: Pushkar Main Bazaar
description: Market street near the lake selling handicrafts, textiles and silver jewellery.

name: Jaisalmer Fort
description: Living fort of golden sandstone with shops, hotels and homes inside; entering is free, museums inside charge separately.

name: Patwon Ki Haveli
description: Cluster of merchant mansions with carved sandstone facades.

name: Gadisar Lake
description: Historic reservoir south of the fort, with ghats and small temples.

name: Sam Sand Dunes
description: Desert dunes about 40 km west of Jaisalmer; sunset camel rides and desert camps are paid extras.

name: Chinese Fishing Nets, Fort Kochi
description: Cantilevered fishing nets along the Fort Kochi waterfront, popular at sunset.

name: Mattancherry Palace (Dutch Palace)
description: 16th-century palace museum with Kerala murals; closed on Fridays.

name: Paradesi Synagogue
description: Synagogue in Jew Town dating from 1568; closed on Saturdays and Jewish holidays.

name: St. Francis Church, Fort Kochi
description: One of the oldest European-built churches in India.

name: Jew Town and Antique Market
description: Lane of antique, spice and curio shops next to the synagogue.

name: Marine Drive, Kochi
description: Waterfront promenade on the backwater in the city centre.

name: Kayees Rahmathulla Cafe
description: Well-known Mattancherry eatery for Malabar-style biryani.

name: Alappuzha Backwaters (Vembanad Lake)
description: Network of canals and lake best seen by houseboat or shared boat; prices vary widely by boat and season.

name: Alappuzha Beach
description: Town beach with an old pier.

name: Eravikulam National Park
description: High-altitude park, home of the Nilgiri tahr; closed to visitors for a period around the calving season (often Feb-Mar). Verify dates.

name: Mattupetty Dam
description: Dam and reservoir about 13 km from Munnar town, with boating.

name: Tea Museum (Kanan Devan Hills)
description: Small museum on the history of tea in the Munnar hills.

name: Munnar Tea Plantations
description: Hillsides of tea estates around the town; viewpoints along the roads are free.

name: Periyar Tiger Reserve and Lake
description: Forest reserve around Periyar Lake; entry and boat rides are ticketed separately.

name: Sree Padmanabhaswamy Temple
description: Major Vishnu temple in the fort area; strict dress code and entry is restricted to Hindus. Verify current rules.

name: Napier Museum
description: 19th-century Indo-Saracenic museum building, next to the zoo.

name: Kovalam Beach
description: Crescent beaches south of the city.

name: Shanghumugham Beach
description: City beach next to the airport, known for sunsets.

name: Varkala Beach and Cliff
description: Beach below a red laterite cliff lined with cafes and shops.
